summary: OKYO Pharma Limited furnished a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing that the clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company will present and participate at upcoming ophthalmic scientific conferences: Eyecelerator on October 8, 2026 in New Orleans, plus the American Academy of Optometry (September 30-October 1, Anaheim) and American Academy of Ophthalmology (October 9-12, New Orleans). CEO Robert J. Dempsey presents on corneal and anterior segment disease unmet needs. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine investor-relations conference announcement, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle.
